name: Hydration Calculator
description: Estimate daily recommended water intake in liters, fluid ounces, and standard cups based on body weight, daily exercise duration, and climate.
search_intent: Calculate daily water intake requirements based on weight and activity level.
keywords: how much water to drink a day
calculation: Baseline requirement: 35 mL per kg body weight (National Academy of Medicine fluid guidelines). Exercise sweat replacement: approximately 350 mL per 30 minutes of moderate activity (approx 11.67 mL per minute). Climate adjustment factor: temperate = 0 mL, hot-dry = +400 mL, hot-humid = +600 mL, cold-high-altitude = +300 mL. Total daily water (liters) = round(((bodyWeightKg × 0.035) + (exerciseDurationMinutes × 0.01167) + (climateFactor / 1000)), 2). Fluid ounces = round(totalLiters × 33.814, 1). Standard 8-oz glasses = round(fluidOunces / 8, 1).
limitations: General wellness estimate only. Individuals with congestive heart failure, chronic kidney disease, or on diuretic medications require strict physician-prescribed fluid restrictions.
Dietary water from fresh fruits, vegetables, soups, and beverages typically contributes 20-30% of total daily fluid intake.
Extreme endurance athletics in hot environments requires monitored electrolyte and sodium replenishment to avoid hyponatremia.
